text: [tired, quiet] Seven wins on the bounce. Now three defeats. [sighs] I don't recognise this team.
Three league defeats in a row for City. One question. Is it Enzo... or Maresca?
[angry, fast] A hundred and twenty-five million quid, and what does he actually do? Drop him!
[passionate, raised voice] Don't put it on Enzo! Maresca brought him here and he'll never drop him. That's on the manager, mate.
[laughing] My wife said go, enjoy Manchester. [laughs] Two-nil down after eighteen minutes! I'm telling her we won.
[calm, firm] Neither. Guéhi and Gvardiol both off at half-time, eight games without a clean sheet. Fix the defence first.
Want Enzo out of the team? On ACTXION, Starting 11 lets you pick your XI before kick-off, and it goes to the club and the manager.
Enzo, or Maresca? You tell us.
